title: Per-layer sensitivity map + simulated rollback harness for FP8 enablement on Hopper (E4M3/E5M2)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a robust per-layer sensitivity mapping and a simulated rollback harness to safely enable FP8 profiles (E4M3/E5M2) for selected Hopper model families. This ticket covers the calibration replay tooling, deterministic golden prompts, cross-batch variance gating heuristics, and an automated rollback simulation that exercises the same decision tree used in production rollouts.
background: Previous FP8 activation runs revealed bursty instabilities on deep attention layers under certain batch compositions and long-context workloads. Existing calibration pipelines surface aggregate metrics but lack per-layer severity signals and an offline way to validate the rollback path without affecting live traffic. We need a deterministic way to quantify per-op sensitivity, stress the activation logic, and confirm rollback decisions will match production when triggered by drift or QoS regressions.
tasks: Design per-layer sensitivity metric set (max-abs-delta, mean-rel-delta, softmax-shift, kv-cache-drift) and document calculation formulas
Implement calibration-replay harness that replays recorded inference traces (seq lengths, batch shapes, prompt seeds) into FP8-simulated runtime and compares outputs to FP32 baseline
Add a simulated rollback engine that runs the same model-selector decision logic and validates fallback to INT8/FP32 variants deterministically
Create golden prompt set (1k prompts across domains) and a deterministic RNG seed scheme for reproducible comparisons
Integrate cross-batch variance gates and hysteresis thresholds into selector logic and expose sampling knobs in the canary config
Author CI jobs: fp8-sim-ci (unit + integration), fp8-shadow-eval (nightly), and quant-profile-validator (pre-merge checks)
Add telemetry hooks for 95th/99.9th latency, per-op error histograms, and rollback-count events
Run full validation with three model families (gpt-like-20b, instruction-13b, reranker-2b), capture results and draft rollout playbook
acceptance_criteria: Per-layer sensitivity map produced for each validated model and stored in /artifacts/quant_profiles/sensitivity/<model>/<date>
Golden-run delta: mean token-level logprob delta <= 0.8% and BLEU/ROUGE deltas within expected tolerance for generative families
Cross-batch variance gate prevents FP8 activation if per-layer max-abs-delta > 1.5e-2 or softmax-temp-shift > 0.6 across sampled traces
Simulated rollback reproduces production decision path for 99% of replayed traces (decision parity >= 99%)
CI coverage: fp8-sim-ci passes on PRs touching kernel selection or activation heuristics; nightly shadow-eval runs without exceeding budget more than twice in a week
Telemetry shows no >5% regression in 99.9th token latency for canary config during shadow trials
Runbook drafted and reviewed by ML Research and SRE and stored in Confluence with playbook steps and alert thresholds
progress_updates: 2025-02-18: Ticket created. Scoped metrics and initial design doc outline. Assigned to Carlos.
2025-02-20: Prototype sensitivity metric implemented in calibration-utils; validated on small synthetic traces (gpt-like-1b). Observed layer-7 attention head drift in long-context cases.
2025-02-24: Calibration-replay harness v0 checked into feature branch. Deterministic seed scheme established (seed-source: trace-hash + run-id).

2025-02-27: Simulated rollback engine integrated; initial parity tests against historical canary logs show 92% decision parity. Identified two mismatches due to rounding differences in kernel thresholds.
2025-03-01: Adjusted hysteresis thresholds and added per-op smoothing window; decision parity improved to 99.2% on validation traces. Drafting CI jobs and runbook.
notes_and_risks: Risk: FP8 activation may still fail in rare large-batch, long-context combos not present in replay traces. Mitigation: expand trace corpus and add synthetic stress traces specific to chat-style prefix repetition.
Risk: Telemetry volume may spike when enabling per-op histograms; plan to sample 1% of traffic for full histograms and 100% for aggregate counters.
Follow-up: After rollout, schedule 2-week blackout window for auto-rollback tuning and an on-call SRE rotate for the first production activation week.
